entities.name: Monotheism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The belief in a single, all-powerful God, emerging from ancient Near Eastern traditions. Codified by Moses in the Torah, monotheism became the foundation of Judaism, Christianity, and Islam — the three Abrahamic faiths that shaped global civilization.
